title: Ooh La La Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Recently renovated kitchen and bathrooms, a perfect Seaside escape and family favorite with a tower with incredible gulf and sunset views all within walking steps to the beach and the pool! Three porches, outdoor dining, & tower w/ Gulf Views!
description_expanded: Description785 Forest StreetTWO KINGS, BUNKROOM SLEEPS 2, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA, DAYBED W/TRUNDLE (In 3rd Floor Loft) Prime Seaside Location with Gulf Views & Classic Coastal CharmWelcome to this beloved Seaside beach cottage where timeless Southern charm meets fresh, modern updates. Ideally positioned to capture beautiful views of both the town and the Gulf, this immensely popular vacation rental offers an unforgettable Seaside experience filled with color, character, and comfort. Guests consistently fall in love with its whimsical personality, inviting layout, and incredible outdoor spaces.Extensive Renovation Completed Winter 2021This home has undergone an extensive renovation in Winter 2021, enhancing both style and functionality throughout. Updates include a fully renovated kitchen with quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, and all new appliances, along with beautifully renovated bathrooms and all-new interior and exterior paint, giving the home a refreshed yet classic Seaside feel while preserving its vintage charm.Cheerful Living Spaces Designed for GatheringStep through the front door and you’ll immediately understand why guests say “Ooh-La-La.” The first-floor living room bursts with personality and color, offering comfortable seating and a queen sleeper sofa for additional accommodations. The open flow leads to the dining area, a full bathroom, and the newly renovated kitchen—fully equipped for everything from morning coffee to family dinners. Whether you're cooking together or simply relaxing, this space invites connection and comfort.Comfortable Bedrooms & Elevated Tower ViewsUpstairs, the second floor features three thoughtfully appointed bedrooms. A spacious king primary suite with a private ensuite bath offers a peaceful retreat, while a king bedroom and a twin bunk room share a hallway bathroom—perfect for families or mixed groups. The third-floor loft includes a daybed with a trundle, creating a cozy additional sleeping area and a fun hideaway for kids or teens.Just beyond the loft, the lookout tower awaits—one of the home’s most treasured features. From here, enjoy unforgettable Gulf views, coastal breezes, and spectacular sunsets that make Seaside evenings truly magical.Outdoor Living with Southern StyleOutdoor living is a highlight of this charming cottage. The expanded backyard offers multiple seating areas, a charcoal grill, and an outdoor shower, creating the perfect setup for laid-back afternoons and evenings after the beach. Whether dining alfresco, rinsing off sandy toes, or enjoying a sunset from the tower, every outdoor space is designed to elevate your stay.A True Seaside FavoriteWith its whimsical décor, modern renovations, and iconic tower views, this cottage delivers the perfect blend of Southern elegance, vintage charm, and coastal comfort. From its thoughtful updates to its unforgettable setting, this home remains a favorite for guests seeking a classic Seaside escape with all the modern conveniences already in place.* 5 night minimum Summer & Spring. Only available for rent during Summer season. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES2,378 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach: Odessa PavilionBeach Access: 3-minute walk (176 yards)Outdoor Living: Spacious outdoor dining areaLinens: Peacock Alley Linens — fresh and luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeCommunity Amenities: Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityGuest Services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Carts: 2 parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.Pets: No pets allowedSTR23-002099
